_comment: The Pocket Branch (tutorial) case file. Kept apart from content/plumpurse on purpose: nothing about the tower goes in here. Evidence for this floor comes from content/plumpurse/evidence.json items with floor 0.
title: Pocket Branch
author: Krystal Klear
intro: Small branch across the street, one teller, one cash bag. Practice here. Read the cards, then go be the courier.

people.name: Barry Biscuit
people.title: Teller
facts: Wants out by 5:00. Help him leave.
Can't lock up until the Swiftbag courier has been.

vendors.name: Swiftbag Couriers
vendors.card: Armored courier. Picks up the cash bag at closing; fee paid on the spot.

notices.title: Closing time
notices.body: The branch closes at five. The courier collects the cash bag before Barry locks up.

notices.title: Swiftbag pickup card
notices.body: End-of-day cash pickup. Fee 0.50 to 1 dollar, paid on the spot from the Piggy Bank.
